categories.nameZh: 智能体操作系统与应用

speakers.name: David Heinemeier Hansson (DHH)
speakers.roleOrg: Creator of Ruby on Rails & Omarchy
speakers.bio: David Heinemeier Hansson (DHH) is the creator of Ruby on Rails and Omarchy, a co-owner and co-founder of 37signals, and a best-selling author. He co-authored REWORK, REMOTE, It Doesn't Have to Be Crazy at Work, and Getting Real with Jason Fried. He also chairs the Rails Foundation and serves on Shopify's board of directors.

speakers.name: Charles Yang
speakers.bio: Charles Yang is a core technical instructor for Agentic AI and Physical AI at AMD China and an architect focused on AI ecosystem development.

speakers.name: Peilin Li
speakers.roleOrg: Ph.D. Student, Tsinghua University / Approaching AI
speakers.bio: I am currently a Ph.D. student at Tsinghua University under the supervision of Prof. Mingxing Zhang. I am a core contributor to the open-source projects KTransformers and LLaMA-Factory. My research focuses on inference and fine-tuning on heterogeneous GPU–CPU systems, and large-scale cluster inference optimization.

speakers.name: Wilson Wang
speakers.bio: Software Engineer at ByteDance’s Global Traffic Infra, specializing in Virtual Machines and WebAssembly. I have a strong interest in operating systems, distributed systems, cloud-native technologies, edge computing, and serverless architecture.

speakers.name: Peng Zhang
speakers.bio: Peng Zhang is the founder of Genmeta Technology and an advocate for DHttp.

speakers.name: Shiwei Liu
speakers.roleOrg: Group Leader, Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems / ELLIS Institute Tübingen
speakers.bio: Shiwei Liu leads a research group at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and is a Principal Investigator at the ELLIS Institute Tübingen. Previously, he was a Royal Society Newton International Fellow at the University of Oxford and a postdoctoral fellow at the University of Texas at Austin. He received his Ph.D. with Cum Laude honors from Eindhoven University of Technology in 2022. His work focuses broadly on the full lifecycle of large foundation models.

speakers.name: Jiaqi Zheng
speakers.bio: Jiaqi Zheng is an associate professor and doctoral supervisor at the School of Computer Science, Nanjing University. His current research focuses on supernode interconnection systems. He has presided over projects funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China, including the Excellent Young Scientists Fund, the General Program, and the Young Scientists Fund, as well as corporate innovation funds from Huawei, Alibaba, ByteDance, Tencent, and other companies. He has published over 100 academic papers in top-tier international venues such as SIGCOMM, NSDI, and NIPS, and has received the Best Paper Award at CCF-recommended international conferences three times. Three of his authorized patents have been transferred to Huawei Central Research Institute. His related achievements have been incorporated into core computer science curricula at leading universities in the United States, have been specially cited in the U.S. National Science Foundation's 2024 Milestone Report.

speakers.name: Sébastien Crozet
speakers.bio: Sébastien Crozet has been in love with the Rust programming language since its earliest days. He is the creator and maintainer of popular open-source libraries, including nalgebra and Rapier, for the Rust ecosystem that specialize in linear algebra, geometry, and physics. He is the founder of Dimforge where he focuses on contributing to the future of cross-platform scientific computing and AI.

speakers.name: Liuwang Kang
speakers.roleOrg: Associate Researcher, Shenzhen Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics for Society
speakers.bio: Liuwang Kang received his Ph.D. in Computer Science from the University of Virginia, where he also conducted postdoctoral research. He previously worked as a Senior Project Scientist at VMASC and as a Staff Engineer at Baidu. He is now an Associate Researcher at the Shenzhen Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics for Society, focusing on multi-agent coordination, 6G-enabled embodied intelligence, and complex-system simulation.

speakers.name: Hongjun Zhou
speakers.bio: Hongjun Zhou is an Associate Researcher at the Shenzhen Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics for Society. His research focuses on robot perception, navigation, and bipedal robot control. He previously worked on service and home robot development at Alibaba and the ASUS Intelligent Robot Center.

speakers.name: Tiberiu Socaci
speakers.bio: I'm Tiberiu Socaci, CEO & Co-Founder of Makeitfuture — a leading AI and automation agency across the UK, France, Germany, and Romania. I'm passionate about digital transformation and helping businesses streamline complex workflows using AI, Make.com, Airtable, n8n, and no-code solutions. We worked with companies like Celonis, Avidly, BCG, and Billwerk to simplify processes and drive real growth. The whole thing started with Blu Coffee, Romania's first specialty coffee subscription, which I fully automated using Make.com. That turned into a company that's now delivered 15,000+ automations and been recognized by Make.com as their AI Partner of the Year and #1 No-Code Agency EMEA in 2024. Lately, I've been building a new type of application — self-evolving apps — that learn from user corrections without any machine learning. My mission is to empower organizations by making AI practical, accessible, and smarter with every use.

speakers.name: Peter Ide-Kostic
speakers.roleOrg: Head of EU Policy, OpenMined Foundation
speakers.bio: Peter Ide-Kostic is Head of EU Policy at the OpenMined Foundation, leading its European engagement on AI governance, data policy and privacy-enhancing technologies. He brings more than 15 years of EU technology-policy experience, including as a European Parliament official supporting the LIBE, IMCO and AIDA committee secretariats and the STOA Panel. An EU Fellow and former visiting scholar at UC San Diego, his work focuses on trustworthy AI, responsible data access and European technological sovereignty. He participates in a personal capacity in the European Commission’s Expert Forum on Frontier AI and represented OpenMined at the inaugural UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance in July 2026.

speakers.name: Jacky Hsu
speakers.bio:
Jacky Hsu is the Founder of Ingora, an AI-native learning companion company building next-generation AI companion devices for children.

Previously, he spent over 20 years at Microsoft as a product leader, where he led product strategy and growth initiatives across multiple businesses including SharePoint Copilot and Agent. He played a key role in bringing Copilot and Agent experiences into real-world enterprise scenarios.

Jacky combines deep expertise in AI product design with a unique perspective on integrating agent systems, education, and hardware. At Ingora, he is exploring how AI companions can reshape how children learn, think, and grow.

speakers.name: Satya Mallick
speakers.bio: Dr. Satya Mallick is the CEO of OpenCV.org - the non-profit that maintains the largest computer vision library in the world. He is an entrepreneur in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning. Before starting his AI consulting company, Big Vision LLC, he co-founded Sight Commerce Inc (formerly Taaz Inc.), where he built AI products that reached over 100M users. His work has been covered in publications like TechCrunch, Huffington Post, NYTimes, and WSJ. Dr. Mallick is also the creator of some of the most popular online computer vision and AI courses. In 2017, IBM's AI Blog named Dr. Mallick as one of the top 20 people in AI to follow on Twitter.

speakers.name: Kelly Policarpo
speakers.roleOrg: Founder & CEO, Lumo AI Compliance & Advisory
speakers.bio:
An AI Governance and EU Market Entry expert and the Founder of Lumo AI Compliance & Advisory, a consultancy helping AI companies prepare for the European market.
With a background in Computer Science and Product Management, and professional expertise spanning AI compliance, privacy, cybersecurity, and product strategy, works at the intersection of technology, regulation, and international market expansion.
Her work focuses on helping companies understand what it takes to move from building AI products to becoming ready to enter and scale in the European market. Through practical AI governance and market-readiness strategies, she helps organisations navigate the EU AI Act and the broader governance requirements that increasingly shape access to the European AI ecosystem.
Based in Portugal, Kelly brings a European perspective to the rapidly growing global AI industry, with a particular focus on helping technology companies from Asia and the Greater Bay Area.

speakers.name: Katarzyna Starosławska
speakers.roleOrg: AI, Data & HPC Expert, LUMI AI Factory / CYFRONET AGH / European Commission
speakers.bio:
Katarzyna Starosławska is a data and AI expert with over 20 years of experience at the intersection of technology, strategy, and innovation. She advises boards, public institutions, and European Union.
She focuses on data quality, interoperability, and cross-sector collaboration as foundations for effective and responsible AI solutions.
Current roles:
Member of the expert group on the next generation of interoperability frameworks at the European Commission
Member of the SCIANCE AI in Science Working Groups (AISWGs), European Commission
Senior HCP & AI Specialist, EuroHPC / LUMI AI Factory, CYFRONET AGH
Leader of the “Data for AI” stream and member of the “AI in Public Administration” group, Ministry of Digital Affairs
Member of the Business Council, Speakleash / Bielik.ai Foundation (former Vice President)
External expert for the Medical Research Agency, EIT Health.
She is a frequent speaker and moderator at international technology events, including Web Summit and TechCrunch Disrupt.

speakers.name: Qinying Liao
speakers.bio: Senior AI Product Leader with 10+ years at Microsoft Azure AI, specializing in Speech AI and Voice Agents. Experienced in product strategy, 0-to-1 product development, and global commercialization. Combines B2B and B2C product expertise with deep strengths in human-centered design, AI product experience, and ecosystem development to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into scalable products and lasting business value.

speakers.name: Feliana Citradewi
speakers.bio: Feliana Citradewi is the Founder and CEO of Global AI Assembly.

speakers.name: Markus Tavenrath
speakers.bio:
Markus Tavenrath studied computer science with a focus on computer graphics at RWTH Aachen University. This academic background provided a solid foundation for his career in the technology industry.

In 2008, Markus joined NVIDIA, where he began working on real-time ray tracing on GPUs. Over the years, he has contributed to performance optimization for ray tracing, scene graphs, OpenGL, WebGL, Vulkan, and AI. His work has played a role in advancing these technologies.

Markus is also a co-founder of the Vulkan-Hpp project, which has been beneficial to the Vulkan community. His efforts have helped improve the use and implementation of Vulkan.

Recently, Markus was elected as the Chair of the ML Council at Khronos. In this role, he helps coordinate and support AI and machine learning initiatives within the Khronos group. His election to this position reflects his expertise and leadership qualities.

Markus Tavenrath is a dedicated professional whose contributions have positively impacted the technological landscape at NVIDIA and beyond.

speakers.name: Igor Schwarzmann
speakers.bio: Strategic advisor at the intersection of culture and technology. 20 years of experience across Health, Automotive, Luxury, Media, and Government — working with global technology companies, European multinationals, and institutions in the US, Europe, China, and Singapore. Principal of Known Unknowns GmbH, Berlin. At GOSIM Paris 2026 he spoke on the "Europe in the Age of Agentic AI" panel and moderated the panel on AI and Education. He runs his practice on his own agentic AI infrastructure — open-source, local-first, no cloud dependencies — and writes about strategy and AI at igorschwarzmann.com. Host of *Follow the Rabbit*, a podcast on cultural phenomena and European AI sovereignty.

speakers.name: CodingMa
speakers.bio: CodingMa holds a master's degree from Peking University and has worked extensively on training systems for NLP and large language models. At Huawei, he focuses on building the native open-source ecosystem for Ascend training, leads technical collaborations and planning with post-training communities, and contributes as a committer to LLaMA-Factory.

speakers.name: Charbel Dandjinou
speakers.bio: Charbel Dandjinou is the founder and CTO of Reflexion Robotics, a Paris-based startup building A OS, a safety runtime for embodied AI. Previously an AI research engineer and MLOps technical lead at EXXACT Robotics, he also founded IROKO and the Deep Takka research lab to make AI more accessible and inclusive.

speakers.name: Alba María Téllez Fernández
speakers.bio: Alba María Téllez Fernández is AI Lead at Marso Robotics and the main developer of the open-source simulation projects AlpaBridge and URDF Studio. She works at the intersection of world models, agentic AI, and cybersecurity for robotics and autonomous vehicles.

speakers.name: Meiyi Qiang
speakers.bio: Meiyi Qiang is a core developer of the OpenDCAI open-source projects, with a focus on the DataFlow AI data preparation system and the DataFlex dynamic training system. Her work spans data-centric AI, data-model co-training, and dynamic data optimization. She has published seven papers in CCF-A journals and conferences and now leads AI data infrastructure solutions and commercialization as Co-Founder of Yuanshu Zhihui.

speakers.name: Anastasia Stasenko
speakers.bio: Anastasia Stasenko is Co-Founder and CEO of Pleias, a Franco-German lab developing data infrastructure for frontier AI systems. Under her leadership, Pleias created Common Corpus, an open multilingual dataset for LLM training with more than two trillion tokens, and led SYNTH, which produces open synthetic data at scale for sovereign AI models and agentic applications. She is also a Senior Associate Lecturer at Sorbonne Nouvelle University and came to AI through digital humanities and philosophy at the École Normale Supérieure.

speakers.name: Nouamane Tazi
speakers.bio: Nouamane Tazi is a Machine Learning Research Engineer at Hugging Face, specializing in training large language models. He is a co-author of SmolLM3 and The Ultra Scale Playbook, and his research spans NLP, deep learning, and scalable AI infrastructure.

speakers.name: Martino Russi
speakers.bio: Aspiring mad scientist, trying to create this generation's Pinocchio. Martino Russi is a core contributor to LeRobot, the open-source robotics library, where he built and maintains the Unitree G1 humanoid stack. He is the creator of Project Homunculus, an open-source force-feedback hand exoskeleton that subsequent academic work, including HOMIE, builds on. His background spans neuroscience, AI, and robotics; his goal is to make embodied intelligence affordable for everyone.

speakers.name: Yuegang Liu
speakers.roleOrg: Vice Principal, Sun Yat-sen University Affiliated School (Shenzhen)
speakers.bio: Yuegang Liu is a senior secondary-school art teacher and Vice Principal of Sun Yat-sen University Affiliated School in Shenzhen. Over more than 20 years in education, he has worked on school culture, brand and design management, and AI-supported collaborative learning. He developed the Three-Person Learning Group model, combining Confucian differentiated instruction with Vygotsky's zone of proximal development through intelligent grouping, collaborative inquiry, and multidimensional assessment.

speakers.name: Bryce Adelstein Lelbach
speakers.bio:
Bryce Adelstein Lelbach has spent over a decade developing programming languages, compilers, and libraries. He is passionate about parallel programming and strives to make it more accessible for everyone.

Bryce is a Principal Engineer at NVIDIA, where he founded the Core C++ Compute Libraries team and now leads the Vanguard Programming group that drives NVIDIA's roadmap for programming languages, compilers, and core libraries.

He is a leader of the systems programming language community, having served as chair of the C++ Library Evolution and the US programming language standards committee. He has been an organizer and program chair for many conferences over the years. On the C++ committee, he has worked on concurrency primitives, parallel algorithms, senders, and multidimensional arrays.

Outside of work, Bryce is passionate about airplanes and watches. He lives in Midtown Manhattan with his girlfriend and dog.

speakers.name: Quanshi Zhang
speakers.roleOrg: Associate Professor, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
speakers.bio: Quanshi Zhang is a tenured Associate Professor and Ph.D. advisor in the School of Computer Science at Shanghai Jiao Tong University. His internationally recognized research focuses on the interpretability of neural networks. He received his Ph.D. from the University of Tokyo in 2014 and conducted postdoctoral research at UCLA from 2014 to 2018. He is a recipient of the ACM China Rising Star Award and has served in editorial and senior program roles for TMLR, NeurIPS, ICML, IJCAI, AAAI, and CVPR.

speakers.name: Susanna Wong
speakers.bio: Susanna Wong is a Staff AI Engineer at Typeform, building products with cutting-edge AI. Her software-engineering experience spans startups and global companies, with expertise in web development, GraphQL, and generative AI. She is a Google Developer Expert in web technologies, serves on the Google Developer Advisory Board, and has spoken at conferences worldwide.

speakers.name: Anni Lai
speakers.roleOrg: Generative AI Commons Co-Chair, LF AI & Data
speakers.bio: Anni Lai is Co-Chair of the Generative AI Commons and a board member of LF AI & Data.

speakers.name: Zhihong Mo
speakers.roleOrg: EDA Ecosystem & University Program Lead, JLC Technology Group
speakers.bio: Zhihong Mo is the higher-education manager and ecosystem platform lead at JLC Technology Group, as well as the initiator of the Open Source Hardware Platform. He works to expand the use of domestic PCB design tools in education and to build an open hardware ecosystem connecting developers, universities, and industry.

speakers.name: Bartłomiej Szejny
speakers.bio:
Bartłomiej Szejny is a technology entrepreneur, independent AI researcher, and board member of AI Poland. He contributes to the development of Poland’s artificial intelligence ecosystem by combining business, technological, and strategic perspectives. His research interests focus on autonomous embodied AI agents and control mechanisms inspired by neurobiology.

He is the author of the position paper “Embodied Agents in Open-Ended Environments Require a Stress-Gated Homeostatic Meta-Controller,” submitted as a preprint in the cs.AI category. The paper introduces the SGHMC architecture, which uses a slowly evolving stress variable to coordinate reactive and deliberative behavior while maintaining explicitly defined safety boundaries. The work proposes a falsifiable research programme exploring machine homeostasis as a potential foundation for the safe autonomy of AI systems operating in open-ended and unpredictable environments.

speakers.name: Xin Dong
speakers.roleOrg: Program Director, Huawei Programming Language Lab
speakers.bio: Xin Dong is a Program Director at Huawei Programming Language Lab, leading core technology development for programming languages and IDE infrastructure. He previously worked on Microsoft Azure and Dynamics 365, and later led initiatives across Huawei's mobile AI tools, Ascend AI toolchain, HarmonyOS toolchain, and company-wide AI development platforms.

speakers.name: Birgitta Böckeler
speakers.bio: Birgitta is a software developer, architect and technical leader with over 20 years of experience in technology and software consulting, during which she has seen many organisations and teams succeed and fail at delivering valuable software. Most recently she worked at Thoughtworks, where she was a Distinguished Engineer and subject matter expert for AI-assisted software delivery since 2023.

speakers.name: Zixi Liu
speakers.bio: Zixi Liu holds a Ph.D. from Nanjing University and works at Huawei's Programming Languages Laboratory in the 2012 Laboratories, focusing on programming languages and AI research.

speakers.name: Fahua Jin
speakers.bio: Fahua Jin is Co-Founder and CTO of EMQ, where he leads product and R&D. He has initiated and contributed to multiple open-source projects and previously worked as a Senior Architect at IBM China Software Development Lab.

speakers.name: Chenghao Rong
speakers.bio: Chenghao Rong graduated from Tsinghua University. He joined Huawei in 2024, where he works on the research and development of AI infrastructure, focusing on post-training and LLM inference.

speakers.name: Bardia Moshiri
speakers.bio: Embedded software engineer specializing in mobile GNU/Linux systems, with experience spanning operating system development, hardware enablement, and platform integration. My work focuses on advancing open-source mobile technologies and exploring the role of Linux in the next generation of mobile computing.

speakers.name: Chen Xin
speakers.bio: Chen Xin is a maintainer of the openEuler Embedded SIG with long-term experience in embedded real-time operating systems, heterogeneous computing, and robotics software stacks. Within the openEuler community, Chen leads architecture and release evolution for projects including IB-Robot, MICA, and UniProton.

speakers.name: Zhichao Jiao
speakers.bio: Zhichao Jiao is a Developer Experience Product Manager at Agora.

speakers.name: Chris Simmonds
speakers.bio: Chris Simmonds is a software consultant and professional geek living in Northern England. He has more than two decades of experience in designing and building open-source embedded systems. He is a big believer in Open Source and the importance of community.  He is the author of the book “Mastering Embedded Linux Programming”, and is the moving force behind the aosp-devs developer community. He is a frequent presenter at open source and embedded conferences, including the Linux Foundation Embedded Linux Conference and FOSDEM. You can see some of his work on the “Inner Penguin” blog at 2net.co.uk

speakers.name: Fanshi Zhang
speakers.bio: Literally full stack developer. Coder and builder grants more than 50k stars. Covering CNCF area, AI  training, and agentic

speakers.name: Hsuan Han Lai
speakers.roleOrg: Lead of Developer Ecosystem, Tuya Smart Inc
speakers.bio:
Tuya Smart | Lead of Developer Ecosystem
TuyaOpen Open Source Project Tech Lead & Agent OS Foundation Architect
- Focusing on building the next-generation Agentic AI Hardware Framework
- Former Product Engineering Director, Vibe Inc.

speakers.name: Xuewen Gao
speakers.roleOrg: Deputy Chief Engineer & Security Architect, QI-ANXIN
speakers.bio: Xuewen Gao is Deputy Chief Engineer and Security Architect at QI-ANXIN, with 20 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, product development, and solution architecture. His work spans DevSecOps, code security, SOAR, threat intelligence, security operations, data governance, and AI security.

speakers.name: Gregory Terzian
speakers.bio: Gregory Terzian is the founder of FOSS (Shanghai) Technology Consulting and a maintainer of the Servo browser engine.

speakers.name: Yuning Liang
speakers.bio: Yuning Liang is the founder and CEO of DeepComputing, which develops RISC-V products including laptops, tablets, workstations, vehicles, and drones. He has a hands-on background in embedded systems, platform APIs, and system software, and received the RISC-V Community Contributor Award in 2024.

speakers.name: Yuu
speakers.bio: Yuu, also known as tommy0103, is the author of Obelisk, an open-source evidence layer that unifies coding-agent session history in a queryable SQLite index. Her work focuses on agent runtimes, CodeAct-style interfaces, local-first data layers, and the tooling needed for intensive multi-agent workflows.

speakers.name: Yaowei Zheng
speakers.bio: Yaowei Zheng is Co-Founder and CTO of PrismShadow and a Ph.D. student in computer science at Beihang University. He created the open-source LlamaFactory fine-tuning framework and now leads PenguinHarness, an open and transparent self-evolving agent engine designed to support more than 1,000 models.

speakers.name: Tess Kassier
speakers.bio: Tess Kassier is a Yale Ventures Entrepreneur-in-Residence, founder, and fractional go-to-market and ecosystem lead at RiseLink, the US innovation arm of Beken. She helps early-stage companies turn product learning into enterprise sales and global hyperscaler partnerships.

speakers.name: Vincent Caldeira
speakers.bio: Vincent Caldeira is Red Hat's APAC CTO and an Industry Visiting Scholar at Columbia University. With more than 20 years in financial-services technology, he works across open source, cloud-native systems, AI safety, sustainability, and digital sovereignty, and holds leadership roles in several Linux Foundation communities.

speakers.name: Yuheng Chen
speakers.roleOrg: AI Researcher & Embedded Systems Specialist, ambi
speakers.bio: Yuheng Chen is a serial entrepreneur, AI researcher, and embedded-systems specialist at ambi. Since 2022, he has explored Rust for embedded product development and helped deliver more than 30 software and hardware products. His current work focuses on combining Rust and AI to create AI-native embedded products and new end-to-end development workflows.

speakers.name: Tong Ling
speakers.roleOrg: Head of IoT Product Commercialization, Espressif Systems
speakers.bio: Tong Ling leads IoT product commercialization at Espressif Systems, advancing the ecosystem and commercial adoption of its open-source IoT platform. His interests span technology, business, philosophy, and human-centered product development.

speakers.name: Xin Liu
speakers.bio: Xin Liu is a Principal Researcher at Huawei and the founder of Jiuwen Symbiosis.

speakers.name: Bo Tang
speakers.bio: Bo Tang leads applied algorithms at MemTensor and is responsible for the development and deployment of MemOS and ClawForce. His research spans natural language processing, reinforcement learning, and safe reinforcement learning, with extensive experience turning advanced algorithms into production systems.

speakers.name: Yanzhi Wang
speakers.bio: Yanzhi Wang is a professor of electrical and computer engineering at Northeastern University. His research focuses on real-time and energy-efficient deep learning and AI systems, particularly efficient large language models and large-scale generative AI systems.

speakers.name: Kerry Zhu
speakers.bio: Kerry Zhu is a professor at Tongji University and a Distinguished Member of the China Computer Federation. He has worked in software-engineering education and research for nearly three decades, with a focus on software testing, quality assurance, and intelligent software engineering.

speakers.name: Philipp Oppermann
speakers.bio: Philipp Oppermann is a freelance Rust developer from Germany working on the Dora robotics framework and operating-system development in Rust. He is the author of the Writing an OS in Rust blog and the main editor of the This Month in Rust OSDev newsletter.

speakers.name: Jiechen Liu
speakers.roleOrg: Director of Ecosystem & Technology, Magic Data
speakers.bio: Jiechen Liu is Director of Ecosystem and Technology and Head of Algorithm Engineering at Magic Data. He leads AI data infrastructure, industry AI solutions, and ecosystem partnerships, with a focus on embodied intelligence and voice agents for intelligent cockpits and home-service robots. His expertise includes multimodal dataset construction, voice-interaction optimization, domain-shift mitigation, and compliant data strategies.

speakers.name: Shuyue Hu
speakers.bio: Shuyue Hu is a research scientist at Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory. Her research focuses on agents, multi-agent systems, large language models, and game theory. She received her Ph.D. from the Chinese University of Hong Kong in 2019 and was a research fellow at the National University of Singapore. Her work has received the First Prize of the Natural Science Award from the Chinese Institute of Electronics, the DAI 2025 Best Paper Award, an AAMAS 2026 Best Student Paper nomination, and the AAMAS 2026 Best System Demonstration Award.

speakers.name: Che Jiang
speakers.roleOrg: Ph.D. Candidate & Algorithm Researcher, Tsinghua University / Frontis.AI
speakers.bio: Che Jiang is a Ph.D. candidate at Tsinghua University and an Algorithm Researcher at Frontis.AI. His research focuses on AI4AI, self-evolving agents, automated machine learning engineering, and AI for scientific discovery. His recent work includes NatureBench and Frontis-MA1/OpenMLE.

speakers.name: Ning Liu
speakers.roleOrg: Algorithm Expert, Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics
speakers.bio: Ning Liu earned his Ph.D. from Northeastern University in the United States. He has published more than 40 papers in leading conferences and journals, including NeurIPS, CVPR, ICML, and IEEE TNNLS, and chairs the IEEE Standards Working Group on AI for Edge Devices.

speakers.name: Michael Berns
speakers.bio: Michael Berns is Head of AI at the Eclipse Foundation. With more than 23 years of international experience, he works at the intersection of open-source AI, digital transformation, and global ecosystem development, advancing vendor-neutral innovation, transparent technology standards, and digital sovereignty.

speakers.name: Cen Ming
speakers.roleOrg: Professor, Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications
speakers.bio: Cen Ming is a professor at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications. He received his Ph.D. in optical engineering from the Graduate School of the Chinese Academy of Sciences in 2006. His research interests include information fusion, multi-target tracking, autonomous driving, and intelligent robotics.

speakers.name: Baofeng Wang
speakers.roleOrg: Co-founder, Shanghai Mood Perception Intelligence Technology
speakers.bio: Baofeng Wang is a co-founder of Shanghai Mood Perception Intelligence Technology and holds an EMBA from Shanghai Jiao Tong University's Antai College. With more than 20 years of experience across internet and technology businesses, he now focuses on brain-computer interfaces, AI wearables, and agentic devices that bring perception, understanding, and feedback into real-world human-computer interaction.

speakers.name: Chenzhe Jing
speakers.roleOrg: Head of Open Source Ecosystem, ModelBest
speakers.bio: Chenzhe Jing leads the open-source ecosystem at ModelBest and supports the company's Chief Scientist. He also leads advocacy and operations for the OpenBMB community. His work spans developer communities, industry partnerships, on-device large models, intelligent hardware, and the commercialization of AI technology.

speakers.name: Iaroslav Neverov
speakers.bio: Iaroslav Neverov is a full-stack engineer at Pleias, a Paris-based AI company building the data layer for enterprise agentic AI. An École 42 graduate, he co-authored Pleias research on local, offline AI for knowledge work, including retrieval and RAG pipelines running on low-cost hardware.

speakers.name: Bohua Zhan
speakers.roleOrg: Technical Expert, Huawei Programming Language Lab
speakers.bio: Bohua Zhan is a technical expert at Huawei Programming Language Lab. He earned his Ph.D. in mathematics from Princeton University in 2014 and later held postdoctoral positions at MIT and the Technical University of Munich. His research covers automated reasoning, interactive theorem provers, embedded-system modeling and verification, and applications in operating systems, distributed systems, and quantum programs.

speakers.name: Weiqi Zhao
speakers.roleOrg: Global Head of Open Ecosystem, Rokid
speakers.bio: Weiqi Zhao leads Rokid's global developer and partner ecosystem for AI and AR glasses. A serial entrepreneur in China and the United States, he has spent more than a decade building intelligent-hardware and spatial-computing products. His current work focuses on agentic AI, human-computer interaction, open standards, developer platforms, and human-centered wearable computing.

speakers.name: Yi Ru
speakers.bio: Yi Ru is the founder and CEO of Lawaken Technology and a veteran smart-hardware entrepreneur with more than 20 years of consumer-electronics experience. He previously led intelligent terminals at Alibaba AI Labs, served as General Manager of Tmall Genie, and was a partner at Xiaomi TV. He founded Lawaken in 2021 to develop AI-powered consumer electronics and smart glasses.

speakers.name: Chao Du
speakers.bio: Chao Du leads the openvela open-source project at Xiaomi. He has more than a decade of experience in open-source and ecosystem operations across cloud computing and telecommunications, and previously founded the IMGeek developer community.

speakers.name: Willem Jiang
speakers.roleOrg: Independent Open Source & Agentic AI Consultant
speakers.bio: Willem Jiang is an independent open-source and agentic AI consultant and a maintainer of DeerFlow. He previously worked at ByteDance's OSPO, served on the Apache Software Foundation Board of Directors, and contributed to Apache Camel, CXF, ServiceMix, and ServiceComb. His earlier roles include open-source technical expert at Huawei and Principal Engineer at Red Hat.

speakers.name: Xin Tan
speakers.bio: Xin Tan is a Solutions Architect at Google Cloud, focusing on applications of frontier AI technologies in the gaming industry.
